newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks seen climbing towards 600 mark.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks seen climbing towards 600 mark.

text.p: Argentine stocks were expected to open firm and cruise towards the psychological barrier of 600 Wednesday, dealers said.

"The market looks good. Most company results have come in well and the U.S. long bond yield drop (to 6.44 percent) helps," said Juan Pablo Paillot of Rabello traders. "There may be some mild profit-taking, but the market should be able to soak it up thanks to new private pension fund purchases."
The weighted MerVal index .MERV rose 0.9 percent Tuesday to 592.97, stretching gains so far this month to four percent. It rose 2.1 percent in October and 9.7 percent in September.
"It would be logical to see a brief sideways drift at this stage but the undertone remains very firm, as seen in the higher turnover," said a dealer at a U.S.-based bank.
Floor volume picked up to a strong 29.8 million pesos Tuesday, or about twice the recent daily average.
Analysts noted local conditions favored the bolsa's bullish run, which they saw lasting through December.
"The domestic political scenario has calmed down and analysts are more optimistic about the pace of economic recovery," said Paillot.
